description_sq:

💡 Ideale për banim familjar ose investim.
📞 Për më shumë informacion ose një vizitë në pronë, na kontaktoni!
description_en: A 2+1 apartment is offered for sale, functionally organized and with good living standards, in a quiet and easily accessible area. 📐 Organization: • Spacious living room with built-in kitchen • 2 comfortable bedrooms • 2 bathrooms ✨ Features: • Natural lighting throughout the day • Modern and quality furniture • Equipped with electrical appliances • Well-organized spaces for maximum comfort 📍 Location: The area offers tranquility, but at the same time quick access to main roads, public transport and any necessary services such as markets, pharmacies, etc. 🚗 Parking post available at extra price: €25,000 💡 Ideal for family living or investment. 📞 For more information or a visit to the property, contact us!
